description.value: Wilderness Rim Resort sits on the eastern shore of Nimpo Lake in BC's Chilcotin Plateau, roughly 185 miles west of Williams Lake on Highway 20 toward Bella Coola. The resort offers a range of cabin options from rustic units to the spacious lakefront Mt. Trumpeter cabin, plus RV and tent sites, making it a practical basecamp for the remote west-Chilcotin cycling corridor. Nimpo Lake is also BC's largest floatplane base, giving the resort an unusually wild and scenic setting near Tweedsmuir Provincial Park.

address.value: P.O. Box 49 Nimpo Lake, BC V0L 1R0

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and corroborates the OSM phone number and URL. The rates page explicitly mentions 'Free WiFi and firewood,' and both the front-page cabin description and the rates page mention laundry facilities (shower houses and laundry for RV/tent guests; washer/dryer inside Mt. Monarch Cabin). No mention of bike storage, bike procedures, or any cycling-specific infrastructure anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM address field is blank; physical address not given on website (only P.O. Box 49, Nimpo Lake). No cycling-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the site.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating resort with an active website, bookable cabins, and RV/tent sites — a practical overnight stop for cyclists riding the remote Highway 20 Bella Coola corridor.
